errors_encountered.error: FusedLocationProviderClient hangs indefinitely when GPS hardware is disabled
errors_encountered.solution: Wrap getFreshLocation in withTimeoutOrNull(8000L) and clean up CancellationTokenSource

errors_encountered.error: Cloudflare/EVCS rate-limiting bans prolonged by repeated client requests during 429 cooldown
errors_encountered.solution: Check isGlobalRateLimited() prior to socket creation and fail immediately with RateLimitException

errors_encountered.error: Audio focus ducking permanently stuck if third-party TTS engine hangs without onDone callback
errors_encountered.solution: Implement a 6-second watchdog timer in FocusModeTtsManager to force abandonDuckAudioFocus()

decisions_made.decision: Single Test File Verification per Phase
decisions_made.reason: Enforces strict isolation and prevents test bloat; only exactly one comprehensive test is created and run per phase

decisions_made.decision: Two-Pronged Click-Spam Defense (UI State + Engine Debounce)
decisions_made.reason: Combines immediate UI feedback (disabling buttons in-flight) with repository/helper debouncing (idempotent MapNavigator, Mutex locking) for bulletproof user interaction safety
Ensures Foreground Service and Notification Fallback modes deliver critical real-time alerts without being silently swallowed by OS
